noeuds.schema: Inputs: Shape, Direction, Color, Duration (seconds), Center: object (name; circle, star, diamond, heart, hero)  →  Outputs: Next / Right away
noeuds.role: Covers or uncovers the screen with a shape (19 to choose from: circle, star, heart, curtain, clock, checkerboard, swirl…). “Close” covers the screen and it stays covered; “Open” uncovers it. “Next” runs when it's done, “Right away” runs immediately.
noeuds.exemple: circle closing → “Go to scene” → circle opening. To change scene in a single step: “Go to scene with a transition”.

noeuds.nom: Go to scene with a transition
noeuds.schema: Inputs: Scene, Shape, Color, Closing (seconds), Pause while closed (seconds), Opening (seconds), Shape to reopen, Center: object (name; circle, star, diamond, heart, hero)  →  Output: none (end of script)
noeuds.role: Changes scene with a transition: the screen is covered by a shape (circle, star, heart, curtain, swirl… 19 shapes), the new scene arrives, then the screen opens again. There is no output: what happens next is set in “At start” of the new scene.
noeuds.exemple: the door is touched: go to the “House” scene with a circle closing on the hero.
